cards.name: Bellsprout
cards.description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.

cards.name: Durant
cards.description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Bronzor
cards.description: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.

cards.name: Bronzong
cards.description: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.

cards.name: Honedge
cards.description: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.

cards.name: Doublade
cards.description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

cards.name: Scatterbug
cards.description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.

cards.name: Spearow
cards.description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.

cards.name: Fearow
cards.description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!

cards.name: Lickitung
cards.description: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.

cards.name: Lickilicky
cards.description: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.

cards.name: Glameow
cards.description: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.

cards.name: Purugly
cards.description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

cards.name: Spewpa
cards.description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.

cards.name: Indeedee
cards.description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.

cards.name: Vivillon
cards.description: The patterns on this Pokémon's wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.

cards.name: Fomantis
cards.description: It loves the sunshine. When it basks in the sunlight regularly, it grows up with vivid coloration.

cards.name: Lurantis
cards.description: As it slashes into its enemies, it looks like it's dancing. Its elegant appearance has led some to call it the most glamorous Grass Pokémon.

cards.name: Tapu Bulu
cards.description: Although it's called a guardian deity, it's violent enough to crush anyone it sees as an enemy.

cards.name: Blipbug
cards.description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Weepinbell
cards.description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.description: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.

cards.name: Salandit
cards.description: This sneaky Pokémon will slink behind its prey and immobilize it with poisonous gas before the prey even realizes Salandit is there.

cards.name: Salazzle
cards.description: The winner of competitions between Salazzle is decided by which one has the most male Salandit with it.

cards.name: Sizzlipede
cards.description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.

cards.name: Victreebel
cards.description: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.

cards.name: Centiskorch
cards.description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: It is capable of swimming backwards by rapidly flapping its winglike pectoral fins and stout tail.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It stores energy by sleeping at underwater depths at which no other life forms can survive.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
cards.description: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.

cards.name: Galarian Mr. Rime
cards.description: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

cards.name: Remoraid
cards.description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.

cards.name: Octillery
cards.description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

cards.name: Corphish
cards.description: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.

cards.name: Crawdaunt
cards.description: A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.

cards.name: Cacnea
cards.description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.

cards.name: Frillish
cards.description: Legend has it that the residents of a sunken ancient city changed into these Pokémon.

cards.name: Jellicent
cards.description: Whenever a full moon hangs in the night sky, schools of Jellicent gather near the surface of the sea, waiting for their prey to appear.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: Its skin is thick enough to fend off Mareanie's spikes. With its robust teeth, Bruxish crunches up the spikes and eats them.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.

cards.name: Shinx
cards.description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

cards.name: Luxio
cards.description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.

cards.name: Luxray
cards.description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.

cards.name: Pachirisu
cards.description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.

cards.name: Cacturne
cards.description: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.

cards.name: Yamper
cards.description: This gluttonous Pokémon only assists people with their work because it wants treats. As it runs, it crackles with electricity.

cards.name: Boltund
cards.description: It sends electricity through its legs to boost their strength. Running at top speed, it easily breaks 50 mph.

cards.name: Galarian Slowpoke
cards.description: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.

cards.name: Spoink
cards.description: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.

cards.name: Grumpig
cards.description: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

cards.name: Baltoy
cards.description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.

cards.name: Claydol
cards.description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.

cards.name: Chimecho
cards.description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: There's enough psychic power in Espurr to send a wrestler flying, but because this power can't be controlled, Espurr finds it troublesome.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: The defensive instinct of the males is strong. It's when they're protecting themselves or their partners that they unleash their full power.

cards.name: Dottler
cards.description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.

cards.name: Orbeetle
cards.description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.

cards.name: Mankey
cards.description: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.

cards.name: Primeape
cards.description: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.

cards.name: Cubone
cards.description: It wears its mother's skull on its head, so no one knows what its bare face looks like. However, it's clear that it's always crying.

cards.name: Cherubi
cards.description: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!

cards.name: Marowak
cards.description: They thump their bones rhythmically to communicate among themselves. There are nearly 50 different rhythmic patterns.

cards.name: Gligar
cards.description: It flies straight at its target's face then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

cards.name: Gliscor
cards.description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey… Then its elongated fangs do the rest.

cards.name: Timburr
cards.description: Timburr that have started carrying logs that are about three times their size are nearly ready to evolve.

cards.name: Gurdurr
cards.description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there's skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

cards.name: Conkeldurr
cards.description: When going all out, this Pokémon throws aside its concrete pillars and leaps at opponents to pummel them with its fists.

cards.name: Mienfoo
cards.description: They seclude themselves in the mountains and devote themselves to training. The form of their kicks and chops differs from pack to pack.

cards.name: Mienshao
cards.description: When Mienshao lets out a bizarre wail, you're in danger. A flurry of kicks and chops too fast to see is about to be unleashed!

cards.name: Rolycoly
cards.description: It can race around like a unicycle, even on rough, rocky terrain. Burning coal sustains it.

cards.name: Carkol
cards.description: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Cherrim
cards.description: The faint scent that emanates from its full blossom entices bug Pokémon to it.

cards.name: Coalossal
cards.description: While it's engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.

cards.name: Silicobra
cards.description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.

cards.name: Sandaconda
cards.description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.

cards.name: Falinks
cards.description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.

cards.name: Stonjourner
cards.description: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.

cards.name: Zubat
cards.description: Their skin is so thin that they'll be burned if sunlight hits them. When it gets cold out, they gather together to warm one another's bodies.

cards.name: Carnivine
cards.description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.

cards.name: Golbat
cards.description: They can suck down over 10 ounces of blood in one go. They have been known to drink so much blood that they can no longer fly.

cards.name: Crobat
cards.description: It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can't drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

cards.name: Galarian Slowbro
cards.description: If this Pokémon squeezes the tongue of the Shellder biting it, the Shellder will launch a toxic liquid from the tip of its shell.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.

cards.name: Honchkrow
cards.description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.

cards.name: Houndour
cards.description: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.

cards.name: Houndoom
cards.description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.

cards.name: Morpeko
cards.description: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
